entities.summary: Andrii Ivanovych Sybiha is a Ukrainian statesman, diplomat, and jurist who is currently serving as the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine since 5 September 2024. Before that, Sybiha was the Deputy Head of the Office of the President of Ukraine.
